methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages were re-fetched directly for each vendor on 2026-06-19/19: gorilladesk.com/pricing, fieldworkhq.com/pricing, fieldroutes.com/pricing, pestpac.com/pricing, briostack.com (homepage; no pricing page), pocomos.com/pricing and pocomos.com/free-trial. All four published-price vendors (GorillaDesk, Fieldwork, Pocomos, plus per-route/per-tech models) had their exact monthly prices confirmed against the live official pricing pages. Quote-only vendors (FieldRoutes, PestPac, Briostack, ServSuite by FieldRoutes) confirmed to publish NO rates — all set monthlyUsd=null; a null beats a guess. GorillaDesk's /pricing page shows trial CTAs but no duration; the 14-day length is corroborated from another official GorillaDesk page. ServSuite's standalone domain (servsuite.com) lapsed; the canonical fieldroutes.com/servsuite-by-fieldroutes page was used and confirmed quote-only ('Get Quote' / 'Get Demo'). Compliance: only PestPac states a certification (SOC-1, footer) — SOC-2/HIPAA/GDPR left null everywhere. No forever-free plan exists for any vendor (freeTier=false everywhere). accessedAt 2026-06-19.

vendors.name: GorillaDesk
vendors.provenance: Re-fetched gorilladesk.com/pricing on 2026-06-19; plan names, monthly prices (49/99/149) and annual prices (539/1089/1639), and per-route model confirmed directly from the official pricing page. Free-trial DURATION is not stated on /pricing; 14-day length corroborated from another official GorillaDesk page. Integrations from gorilladesk.com/integrations-library/.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: Per route (schedule). Includes unlimited admin/mobile users; only schedule-assigned users require a paid seat. Covers invoicing, estimates, basic routing (up to 25 stops), automated communications, 20 dashboard reports, Square/Stripe payment integration. Annual equivalent $539/year per route (confirmed on official page).

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Per route. Marked Most Popular. All Basic features plus customer portal, online booking, subscription billing, advanced routing with Drive Matrix, review generation, e-signatures, GPS tracking, commission tracking, QuickBooks sync, Zapier integration, time clocking, API access. Annual equivalent $1,089/year per route (confirmed).

plans.name: Growth
plans.notes: Per route. Marked Most Value. All Pro features plus map estimation tools, dynamic estimates, sales pipeline management, smart views, multi-branch support, custom fields and statuses. Annual equivalent $1,639/year per route (confirmed).

limits: Pricing is per route/schedule; each additional route adds one plan fee
Basic plan caps routing at 25 stops per route
SMS add-on: $5/month + text packages ($50 for 1000 texts up to $200 for 8000 texts)
keyFeatures: Route-based per-schedule pricing with unlimited admin users
Chemical/material usage logging for pest control compliance
Built-in review generation and GPS technician tracking
Multi-branch support on Growth plan
